summary_en: This Phase 2 study compares two orders of treatment for patients aged 18 and older with newly diagnosed IDH1 or IDH2 mutated acute myeloid leukemia who are not candidates for intensive induction therapy. Patients receive either an IDH inhibitor (ivosidenib or enasidenib) with azacitidine first, followed by azacitidine with venetoclax, or the reverse order; ivosidenib is taken by mouth once daily on days 1 to 28 of each 28-day cycle, and azacitidine is given IV or SC on set days per cycle. The main outcome measure is not stated in the record; the study is Phase 2.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 compara dos órdenes de tratamiento para pacientes de 18 años o más con leucemia mieloide aguda de diagnóstico reciente y con mutación IDH1 o IDH2 que no son candidatos a quimioterapia de inducción intensiva. Los pacientes reciben primero un inhibidor de IDH (ivosidenib o enasidenib) con azacitidina, seguido de azacitidina con venetoclax, o el orden inverso; el ivosidenib se toma por vía oral una vez al día en los días 1 a 28 de cada ciclo de 28 días, y la azacitidina se administra por vía IV o SC en días establecidos de cada ciclo. El registro no indica la medida de resultado principal; el estudio es de fase 2.
who_for: Newly diagnosed acute myeloid leukemia with an IDH1 or IDH2 mutation
Not a candidate for, or refuses, intensive induction therapy
Creatinine clearance above 40 mL/min and liver and bilirubin levels within the listed limits
not_for: Known active leukemia involving the central nervous system
Any other active cancer needing therapy that would interfere with study results
Uncontrolled infection, or uncontrolled hepatitis B, hepatitis C, or HIV
